summary: Worsened bilateral perihilar/basal edema-like opacity with increased left basilar pleural fluid.

findings.rationale: Relative to the matched prior, the current film shows broader bilateral perihilar and lower lung hazy airspace opacity, especially around both hila, in a pattern more consistent with worsened edema than with a purely technical exposure difference.

The current left lower pleural-based opacity extends higher and obscures more of the matched left base than on the prior exam, supporting increased left pleural fluid, though some superimposed left basilar atelectatic opacity remains.
